subject.title: fix(minimax): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Should MiniMax’s configured provider request policy authorize private-network and dispatcher behavior for media submit, poll, metadata, and provider-returned download URLs?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but it expands the effective scope of an existing security-sensitive configuration setting and therefore requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve provider-wide scope
options.body: Land the PR because it preserves default SSRF denial and applies only explicit sanitized overrides without leaking provider headers to result URLs.

options.title: Keep downloads deny-only
options.body: Pause and define a narrower contract if provider-returned URLs must ignore explicit private-network authorization.

recommendation.title: Approve provider-wide scope
recommendation.body: Land the PR because it preserves default SSRF denial and applies only explicit sanitized overrides without leaking provider headers to result URLs.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest recent merged history across the provider HTTP, retry, timeout, SDK, and MiniMax media surfaces involved in this decision.
